title: 第13章 想好怎么死了么第14章 打他们没打你是吧
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: 叶氏带来的这几个人，全是她的亲弟弟。
也是这十里八乡出了名的混混。
在他们的印象里，王大山是个什么样的人？
就是个三棍子打不出一个闷屁的窝囊废，让往东，不敢往西。
让他跪着，他不敢站着。
所以他们都没把王大山当一回事。
只当是被逼急了的兔子，临死前还要蹬两下腿。
叶氏的二弟冷笑着，上前一步。
他手里把玩着一根短木棍，一步三摇地朝着桌子走了过来。
眼神贪婪地在王大山身上，还有那盆肉上扫来扫去。
“真香啊。”
“你小子，平日里看着老实巴交的，没想到还挺懂享受。”
“这肉味儿，我在镇上的酒楼都没闻到过。”
说着，他走到王大山跟前，居高临下地看着坐着的王大山。
“大外甥，二舅我也不难为你。”
“识相点，把肉，还有银子，全都交出来。”
“然后跪下给你娘磕几个响头，认个错。”
“我们几个当舅舅的，待会下手的时候，还能轻点。”
“也就是打断你一条腿，让你长长记性。”
“若是你不识相……”
“那就别怪舅舅们心狠手辣，让你这辈子都在床上度过了。”
后面的叶氏听到这话，也是一脸的得意。
她双手抱胸，靠在门框上，等着看王大山痛哭流涕的求饶模样。
然而。
王大山听着这些话，脸上的表情没有丝毫变化。
甚至，忍不住冷笑了起来。
“想要吃肉？”
“想要银子？”
“还想打断我的腿？”
“你们配？”
话音未落。
王大山动了。
一股狂暴的气流，骤然从他身上爆发出来。
content_en:
These people brought by Ye Shi are all her biological brothers.
He is also a famous gangster in these ten miles and eight towns.
In their impression, what kind of person is Wang Dashan?
He's just a useless wimp who can't be beaten with three sticks. He's told to go east but doesn't dare to go west.
Make him kneel, but he doesn't dare to stand.
So they didn't take Wang Dashan seriously.
Just think of it as a desperate rabbit, and it will kick its legs twice before dying.
"Heh."
Ye's second brother sneered and took a step forward.
He was playing with a short wooden stick in his hand and walked towards the table with three shaking steps.
His eyes greedily glanced at Wang Dashan and the basin of meat.
"It smells so good."
"You kid, you usually seem to be honest and kind, but I didn't expect you to know how to enjoy yourself."
"I've never smelled this meaty smell in any restaurant in town."
As he spoke, he walked up to Wang Dashan and looked down at Wang Dashan who was sitting there.
"My eldest nephew, my second uncle, I won't make it difficult for you either."
"Be wise and hand over all your meat and money."
"Then kneel down and kowtow to your mother a few times to admit your mistake."
"We uncles can be gentler when we attack later."
"That's just to break one of your legs and make you remember it longer."
"If you don't understand..."
"Then don't blame your uncles for being cruel and making you spend your whole life in bed."
When Mrs. Ye from behind heard this, she also looked proud.
She folded her arms and leaned against the door frame, waiting to see Wang Dashan crying and begging for mercy.
However.
When Wang Dashan listened to these words, the expression on his face did not change at all.
He even couldn't help but sneer.
"Want some meat?"
"Want money?"
"You still want to break my legs?"
"Are you worthy?"
The words have not yet finished.
Wang Dashan moved.
"Boom!"
A violent flow of air suddenly burst out from his body.
title_en: Chapter 13: Have you figured out how to die? Chapter 14: Hit them but not you, right?
